decisions.reason: Although the firm publicly launched the men's coffee-based line, its niche character and weaker fit with the firm's narrow core assortment make it easier in 2022 to stop committing resources when no continued website emphasis is visible after launch.

As a very close extension of an existing facial-care line that was explicitly presented as the newest development, management would be inclined to continue it because prior investment and public commitment can still be justified as part of the core range.
